concept: Roaster's Cut follows a visitor-selected flavor profile through Bergen provenance, physical roasting, product recommendation, brewing, and subscription.
recommendations: Concentrate the strongest continuous choreography in the real-roaster transformation.
Keep all product identities and positions stable while changing recommendation and treatment.
Transform the central mechanism into a portrait chamber and horizontal process strip on mobile.

sections.title: Navigation
sections.role: Orient with roast status and journey progress
sections.connection: Carries selection and position across the route
sections.meaningfulOutcome: Keeps destination and selected profile legible
sections.instruction: Intensity 5 clean modern and heavily animated, not sci-fi.
